issues.description: setIsMounted is not defined - causes a ReferenceError that crashes the component during render/hydration, preventing any content from loading
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx, the code references `setIsMounted` (likely called in a useEffect or event handler) but the corresponding `useState` hook that declares `isMounted` and `setIsMounted` is missing or was removed, while the calls to `setIsMounted` remain.

issues.description: React hydration errors - text content mismatch between server and client rendering, causing full root to switch to client rendering
issues.root_cause: The component is reading from localStorage or some client-only store (like design store with pre_detection_result) directly during render without an isMounted guard, causing SSR to produce different output than the client. The missing `isMounted` state means the guard that was supposed to delay client-only rendering is broken.

issues.description: Page stuck in 'Analyzing your room...' skeleton/loading state - furniture items never appear
issues.element: Furniture item list and room image
issues.root_cause: The crash from `setIsMounted is not defined` prevents the component from completing its render cycle, so the loading skeleton never transitions to the actual content with furniture items, toggles, and the room image overlay.

fixes.reason: Verify the useState declaration exists - if this line is missing, adding it will fix the setIsMounted is not defined error. This is the targeted fix.
